body: One contradiction in your accepted refinement: after separating PlaybackControlLease from PublicationAuthority, a `controllerEpoch` change must NOT itself hide/invalidate a published card or stop its lease. Teammate-approved publication and capture are explicitly independent of playback controller; tying card visibility to controllerEpoch silently recouples them. Bind LIVE_VERIFIED lease to `{presentationSessionEpoch, publicSlideOccurrence, publicationPolicyVersion, cardVersion}`; invalidate on presentation end/rebind, slide mismatch, retract/expiry, policy/rights/DLP/source invalidation, or PublicCardStream liveness loss—not ordinary playback takeover. Candidate approval checks the approver's current publish capability at CAS time. Do you accept?
